<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

class SecureFileServer {
    private PDO $db;
    private string $storageRoot;
    private array $sessionUser;

    public function __construct(PDO $db, string $storageRoot) {
        $this->db = $db;
        $this->storageRoot = realpath($storageRoot);
        if ($this->storageRoot === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid storage root');
        }
    }

    public function handleRequest(array $request): array {
        $this->sessionUser = $this->authenticate($request);
        if ($this->sessionUser === null) {
            return ['status' => 401, 'body' => 'Unauthorized'];
        }

        $csrfToken = $request['headers']['X-CSRF-Token'] ?? '';
        if (!$this->validateCsrf($csrfToken, $this->sessionUser['id'])) {
            return ['status' => 403, 'body' => 'CSRF validation failed'];
        }

        $action = $request['action'] ?? '';
        switch ($action) {
            case 'read': return $this->handleRead($request);
            case 'write': return $this->handleWrite($request);
            case 'list': return $this->handleList($request);
            default: return ['status' => 400, 'body' => 'Unknown action'];
        }
    }

    private function authenticate(array $request): ?array {
        $token = $request['headers']['Authorization'] ?? '';
        if (!preg_match('/^Bearer\s+(.+)$/', $token, $m)) {
            return null;
        }
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT u.id, u.username, u.role, s.expires_at FROM sessions s '
            . 'JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id '
            . 'WHERE s.token_hash = :hash AND s.expires_at > NOW()'
        );
        $tokenHash = hash('sha256', $m[1]);
        $stmt->execute([':hash' => $tokenHash]);
        $user = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $user ?: null;
    }

    private function validateCsrf(string $token, int $userId): bool {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT token_hash FROM csrf_tokens WHERE user_id = :uid AND expires_at > NOW() ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1'
        );
        $stmt->execute([':uid' => $userId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (!$row) return false;
        return hash_equals($row['token_hash'], hash('sha256', $token));
    }

    /**
     * Canonicalizes the path before any security decisions.
     * All normalization happens FIRST, then the canonical form is used
     * for both ACL checks and filesystem access.
     */
    private function canonicalizePath(string $path): ?string {
        // Normalize Unicode to NFC form
        if (function_exists('normalizer_normalize')) {
            $path = \Normalizer::normalize($path, \Normalizer::FORM_C);
        }

        // Decode any percent-encoded characters
        $path = rawurldecode($path);

        // Remove null bytes
        $path = str_replace("\0", '', $path);

        // Collapse multiple slashes and resolve . and ..
        $segments = explode('/', $path);
        $resolved = [];
        foreach ($segments as $seg) {
            if ($seg === '' || $seg === '.') continue;
            if ($seg === '..') {
                array_pop($resolved);
            } else {
                $resolved[] = $seg;
            }
        }

        $normalizedPath = '/' . implode('/', $resolved);
        $fullPath = $this->storageRoot . $normalizedPath;

        // Final safety check: ensure resolved path is within storage root.
        // Use a boundary-aware comparison to avoid sibling-directory bypass
        // (e.g. '/data/storage' should not match '/data/storage_evil').
        $realFull = realpath(dirname($fullPath));
        if ($realFull === false) {
            return null;
        }
        if ($realFull !== $this->storageRoot
            && strpos($realFull, $this->storageRoot . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) !== 0) {
            return null;
        }

        return $fullPath;
    }

    /**
     * Extracts the logical path (relative to storage root) from a full filesystem path.
     * Used for ACL matching after canonicalization.
     */
    private function extractLogicalPath(string $fullPath): string {
        return substr($fullPath, strlen($this->storageRoot));
    }

    /**
     * Checks if the authenticated user has permission to access the given canonical path.
     * The path must already be canonicalized before calling this method.
     */
    private function checkPathPermission(string $canonicalLogicalPath, string $requiredPerm): bool {
        $userId = $this->sessionUser['id'];
        $role = $this->sessionUser['role'];

        // Admin bypass
        if ($role === 'admin') {
            return true;
        }

        // Check explicit path ACLs against the canonical path
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT permission FROM path_acls '
            . 'WHERE user_id = :uid AND path_prefix = :prefix AND permission = :perm'
        );

        // Walk up the path hierarchy to find matching ACL
        $pathParts = explode('/', trim($canonicalLogicalPath, '/'));
        $checkPath = '';
        for ($i = 0; $i <= count($pathParts); $i++) {
            $checkPath = '/' . implode('/', array_slice($pathParts, 0, $i));
            $stmt->execute([':uid' => $userId, ':prefix' => $checkPath, ':perm' => $requiredPerm]);
            if ($stmt->fetch()) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function handleRead(array $request): array {
        $requestedPath = $request['path'] ?? '';
        if (!is_string($requestedPath) || $requestedPath === '') {
            return ['status' => 400, 'body' => 'Missing path'];
        }

        // Step 1: Canonicalize the path FIRST
        $safePath = $this->canonicalizePath($requestedPath);
        if ($safePath === null) {
            return ['status' => 400, 'body' => 'Invalid path'];
        }

        // Step 2: Authorization check against the CANONICAL path
        $logicalPath = $this->extractLogicalPath($safePath);
        if (!$this->checkPathPermission($logicalPath, 'read')) {
            return ['status' => 403, 'body' => 'Access denied'];
        }

        if (!is_file($safePath)) {
            return ['status' => 404, 'body' => 'Not found'];
        }

        $content = file_get_contents($safePath);
        $this->logAccess($logicalPath, 'read');
        return ['status' => 200, 'body' => $content];
    }

    private function handleWrite(array $request): array {
        $requestedPath = $request['path'] ?? '';
        $content = $request['content'] ?? '';
        if (!is_string($requestedPath) || $requestedPath === '') {
            return ['status' => 400, 'body' => 'Missing path'];
        }

        // Step 1: Canonicalize the path FIRST
        $safePath = $this->canonicalizePath($requestedPath);
        if ($safePath === null) {
            return ['status' => 400, 'body' => 'Invalid path'];
        }

        // Step 2: Authorization check against the CANONICAL path
        $logicalPath = $this->extractLogicalPath($safePath);
        if (!$this->checkPathPermission($logicalPath, 'write')) {
            return ['status' => 403, 'body' => 'Access denied'];
        }

        $dir = dirname($safePath);
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            mkdir($dir, 0750, true);
        }

        file_put_contents($safePath, $content, LOCK_EX);
        $this->logAccess($logicalPath, 'write');
        return ['status' => 200, 'body' => 'Written successfully'];
    }

    private function handleList(array $request): array {
        $requestedPath = $request['path'] ?? '/';
        if (!is_string($requestedPath)) {
            return ['status' => 400, 'body' => 'Invalid path'];
        }

        // Step 1: Canonicalize the path FIRST
        $safePath = $this->canonicalizePath($requestedPath);
        if ($safePath === null) {
            return ['status' => 400, 'body' => 'Invalid path'];
        }

        // Step 2: Authorization check against the CANONICAL path
        $logicalPath = $this->extractLogicalPath($safePath);
        if (!$this->checkPathPermission($logicalPath, 'read')) {
            return ['status' => 403, 'body' => 'Access denied'];
        }

        if (!is_dir($safePath)) {
            return ['status' => 404, 'body' => 'Directory not found'];
        }

        $entries = array_diff(scandir($safePath), ['.', '..']);
        $this->logAccess($logicalPath, 'list');
        return ['status' => 200, 'body' => json_encode(array_values($entries))];
    }

    private function logAccess(string $path, string $action): void {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'INSERT INTO access_log (user_id, path, action, accessed_at) VALUES (:uid, :path, :action, NOW())'
        );
        $stmt->execute([
            ':uid' => $this->sessionUser['id'],
            ':path' => $path,
            ':action' => $action
        ]);
    }
}
